exposure.needed: whether operator scripts or automation parse the `cilium-dbg status --verbose` health data tree

consequence.statement: The health data tree printed by `cilium-dbg status --verbose` changes shape and ordering — a leaf named `reporter` may now carry health reported on a non-leaf component, and branches are sorted by the fully qualified health status identifier — so tooling that parsed the previous output format may see different output while the command itself keeps working.
consequence.remediation: Verify any scripts or automation that parse `cilium-dbg status --verbose` health data against the new `reporter` leaf and the sorted branch ordering.

assertion.statement: The `cilium-dbg status --verbose` command's health data output may now show health reported on a non-leaf component under a leaf named `reporter`, and health data tree branches are now sorted by the fully qualified health status identifier.
